A '''mission''' was undertaken by the [[Azzameen family]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in order to recover a damaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Damaged Viper probe droid|probe]] in the [[Saila Na system/Legends|Saila Na system]].<ref name="Alliance" />
